s='''def transform(grid):
    # This grid is a regular array of cells separated by horizontal/vertical bars.
    # Read internal intersections, skipping the outermost boundary tracks.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])

    row_bars=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==base for v in grid[r]) or (sum(v==base for v in grid[r])>w//2 and r%6==0)]

    row_bars=[r for r in range(0,h,6)][1:]
    col_bars=[c for c in range(1,w,4)]

    col_bars=col_bars[1:-1]
